info.name: Basware OAUTH2 authentication APIs AccountingDocuments Vault Indexing API

params.name: vaultId
params.description: Vault ID to be checked from

params.name: size
params.description: Number of items to return. Default is 100, maximum is 1000.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order of the results.  Default is "archiveDate desc".  It is possible to sort by "archiveDate" and "documentDate" fields. Use "asc" or "desc" for ascending or descending order.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for deep pagination. Use the cursor returned in the previous response to get the next page of results. If not provided, the first page is returned.
